action.content:
The King's Decree to His Loyal Subjects

To all my faithful subjects, both near and far,
Who dwell within this realm of sun and star,
Hear now the voice of him who holds the crown,
And let your hearts beat true to his renown.

By royal mandate, signed with hand of might,
I bid you cease your strife and put aside the night
Of discord that hath plagued our peaceful land.
Let every quarrel end, as by my word commanded.

Attend the courts where justice shall be done,
And pay the tolls that keep the realm as one.
No tax shall be withheld, no duty unpaid,
For I am he who guards your life and shade.

If any rebel rises, bold or small,
Against the laws I set to rule them all,
Then know that swift retribution shall befall,
To make the traitor's name a thing of thrall.

Yet to the good, who serve with heart and hand,
I grant my favor, and a noble land.
So stand in awe of power, great and deep,
And bow the knee, while I the scepter keep.

Thus ends my speech, written in ink of state,
To bind your souls to mine, in love and fate.
Long live the King! Long live the golden age!
Obey, or face the wrath of royal rage.||
